v3.8.0_build_66, commit 9fad9770f2ae8542ab1a548a68c1ad1ac690abe0) - only the
parts clap-wrapper compiles:

  base/               steinbergmedia/vst3_base           3d2e82f8e6bff59c1d8b7a27491a29c2286b5206
  pluginterfaces/     steinbergmedia/vst3_pluginterfaces 31d6eeba6daaa3e2a8bfbe3e7a90ca0b7fbfbc1c
  public.sdk/source/  steinbergmedia/vst3_public_sdk     a3911a4615dabbfdfd9d181ee26b05c70c289a95
  CMakeLists.txt, LICENSE.txt, README.md (top level; clap-wrapper reads the
  SDK version from CMakeLists.txt)

Left out: the samples, VSTGUI, documentation, the validator and the cmake
helpers (not used by clap-wrapper).
